skills.name: practice-normative-precision
skills.description: Classify and write precise normative statements.
skills.title: Normative precision
skills.source_version: current Part 2 page and 2026 amendment inspected 2026-09-19
skills.mechanism: Statement type, atomic obligation, objective verification, and informative-note boundary.
skills.overlap_boundary: Uses BCP 14 as Lean's output dialect; it does not replace the BCP 14 skill.

skills.name: practice-verifiable-requirements
skills.description: Write atomic requirements with accountable evidence.
skills.title: Verifiable requirements
skills.mechanism: Accountable actor, atomic action, timing, evidence, verifier, and acceptance gate.
skills.overlap_boundary: Generalises a requirement-quality mechanism; it does not represent NASA governance outside NASA.

skills.name: practice-compliant-contrast
skills.description: Teach a rule through bad and compliant examples.
skills.title: Compliant contrast
skills.mechanism: Rule, explanation, noncompliant example, compliant solution, bounded exceptions, and residual-risk warning.
skills.overlap_boundary: Applies CERT's contrastive structure without claiming generic CERT compliance.

skills.name: practice-use-error-controls
skills.description: Derive controls from foreseeable use errors.
skills.title: Use-error controls
skills.source_id: FDA human factors and usability engineering guidance
skills.mechanism: Task analysis, foreseeable use error, cause, consequence, prevention, detection, and recovery with a control hierarchy.
skills.overlap_boundary: Generalises a risk-analysis pattern; medical-device application still requires the complete FDA guidance and qualified work.

skills.name: practice-state-verification
skills.description: Gate risky work on verified state transitions.
skills.title: State verification
skills.mechanism: Ordered state change, securing, verification, hold point, work, restoration, and verification of restoration.
skills.overlap_boundary: Extracts a state-machine pattern; it is not a substitute for the legal lockout/tagout procedure.

skills.name: practice-transition-checklists
skills.description: Place short checklists at costly transitions.
skills.title: Transition checklists
skills.mechanism: Small confirmation checklist, named coordinator, and stop gate at a high-cost phase transition.
skills.overlap_boundary: Extracts a checklist mechanism; it is not a surgical checklist or clinical protocol.

skills.name: guidance-safety-messages
skills.description: Write safety messages for documents and digital media.
skills.title: Safety messages
skills.source_version: document and electronic-media editions named by the user; source access rechecked 2026-09-19
skills.mechanism: Hazard, consequence, avoidance, timing, placement, prominence, and digital-state delivery.
skills.overlap_boundary: Derived guidance only; the licensed ANSI texts are not bundled or reproduced.

skills.name: guidance-safe-technical-procedures
skills.description: Write safe procedures, not warning-only fixes.
skills.title: Safe technical procedures
skills.mechanism: Safe task design, prerequisite control, correctly placed warning, observable result, and recovery.
skills.overlap_boundary: Optional technical-procedure overlay; it does not make ordinary instructions a military technical manual.

skills.name: practice-versioned-verification-requirements
skills.description: Track versioned requirements to evidence and result.
skills.title: Versioned verification requirements
skills.mechanism: Version-qualified identifier, applicability, evidence, result status, and traceable recheck.
skills.overlap_boundary: Extracts the traceability mechanism; PR #17 contains the broader ASVS assessment routine.

skills.name: practice-implementation-example-traceability
skills.description: Separate required tasks from implementation examples.
skills.title: Implementation-example traceability
skills.source_version: Version 1.1 final; Rev. 1 initial public draft tracked separately
skills.mechanism: Practice, task, notional implementation example, reference, chosen implementation, and evidence.
skills.overlap_boundary: Extracts the notional-example distinction; PR #17 contains the broader SSDF routine.

skills.name: profile-ui-procedure-writing
skills.title: UI procedure writing profile
skills.mechanism: Numbered imperative steps, location before action, input-neutral verbs, completion action, and expected result.
skills.overlap_boundary: Thin rendering profile; existing Lean documentation and accessibility requirements remain authoritative.

skills.name: profile-action-step-structure
skills.description: Order prerequisites and action-bearing procedure steps.
skills.title: Action-step structure profile
skills.mechanism: Prerequisites before procedure and action-bearing steps ordered as optionality, reason/result, location, and action.
skills.overlap_boundary: Thin structure profile; it does not replace the broader writing or documentation skills.

skills.name: practice-modular-information-units
skills.description: Design one bounded information job per module.
skills.title: Modular information units
skills.mechanism: One bounded information job, stable identity, declared dependencies, independent reuse, and controlled versioning.
skills.overlap_boundary: Borrows modular architecture without claiming an S1000D publication, data module, or common-source database.

related_open_prs.16: user-facing standards; unchanged by this pack
related_open_prs.17: remaining standards; broader ASVS and SSDF routines remain separate
